purpose: Real-data v4 baseline prepared so LBI can evaluate current conditions against quantitative history rather than isolated current prints.

macro: Japan nominal GDP fiscal-year level: 2005FY-2025FY (2025FY preliminary)
2026-Q2 real/nominal GDP QoQ and seasonally adjusted annual-rate levels
beauty_retail: Department-store total sales: calendar-year 2021-2025 and monthly 2026-01 to 2026-06
Department-store cosmetics sales: calendar-year 2021-2025 and monthly 2026-01 to 2026-06
Drugstore total and Beauty Care sales: calendar-year 2022-2025
Existing cosmetics shipment, household spend and category structure observations retained
trade: Existing 2026 monthly and H1 provisional trade observations retained

data_rules: Every percentage field states or implies an explicit comparison basis in the metric or field name; naked deltas are not used.
JDSA store-count-adjusted YoY is stored separately as yoy_store_adjusted_pct and is not reconstructed from raw sales values.
GDP observations retain source vintage because GDP is revised retrospectively; a vintage change is not interpreted as an economic event.
Derived values such as annual trade balance are explicitly marked derived_from_official_totals.
Historical baseline observations are context and confirmation layers, not Critical Radar events by themselves.
notes: This file is informational only and is not intended as a frontend dependency.
Production data lives in reports.json, critical-news.json, topic-intelligence.json, commerce-calendar.json and data/economy datasets.
All populated baseline items are based on publicly verified sources available at generation time; unavailable facts are not invented.
Empty series remain explicit backlog targets for future collectors rather than being filled with estimates.
